funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career with a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for publishing monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (up to £8,000) and postdoctoral level or above for higher tier.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel, research time, and related costs for individuals undertaking research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled to start or already undertaking a master’s or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to support students beginning or continuing postgraduate study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country undertaking research on eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount grant to fund research trips for students to examine historical works on paper such as prints, drawings and watercolours.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 (one year) or split over two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based master’s degree in British art, visual culture or architecture, starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that brings new perspectives to British art studies.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based doctorate in British art, visual culture or architecture, starting between April 2027 and April 2028 (includes international applicants).
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research, covering tuition and living costs, to expand understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral level researchers (or equivalent experience) and above.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium for three‑month stay

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to senior) with at least a first degree, undertaking British‑Italian research.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome to support advanced research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
